propositions: rebar doctor's lock census reports four legs but omits compact-worker.lock, which is a stamped advisory lock in .rebar/ managed by compact_trigger alongside enrich-drain
scan_locks cannot report on compact-worker locks held by detached background processes that die between acquire and release, reducing diagnostic coverage for the most likely zombie-lock scenario
compact-worker.lock uses the same stamped-file shape and staleness arbitration as enrich-drain.lock, so it can reuse the existing _existence_report helper without new path logic
the canonical store keying for compact-worker.lock must match compact_trigger's canonical-store derivation (fix 13f78e3165), inherited through scan_locks' canonicalisation of the tracker
test suite must verify free stores report compact-worker as free with no spurious holder and held stores report live/dead holders with correct staleness findings
